title: TikTok Brings Its Ads MCP to Claude, Perplexity and Six More
key_facts: TikTok made its ads MCP server a ready-made connector in eight platforms: Claude, Kimi, Manus, Perplexity, Replit, Snowflake, Tencent WorkBuddy and the IAB Tech Lab Agent Registry.
It announced this at Advertising Week New York on 5 October, in a TikTok Newsroom post.
The server itself launched in May; an Agentic Hub of prebuilt skills was added at the end of June.
The server has around 400 tools; the version in Claude's directory leaves out 26, mostly billing and payment functions.
In Claude it needs a Pro or Max plan and a TikTok for Business account; authorisation lasts 30 days.
TikTok says advertisers using it grew more than 200% since launch (July to September, internal data, no starting figure given).
quote_evidence: TikTok has made its ads Model Context Protocol (MCP) server available as a ready-made connector inside eight AI platforms and registries, including Claude and Perplexity.
The version listed in Claude's directory drops 26 of them, according to TikTok's list of unavailable tools.
why_it_matters_hint: Media buyers can connect TikTok ad accounts to AI assistants without a developer, but money-related tools need manual setup.
notes: The Keyword reports TikTok's announcement; growth figure is TikTok's internal claim. The original is TikTok Newsroom, not read.
